headline: Profit jumps on real estate gains, core leasing stays firm
summary_short: Prologis's Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS rose 85.2% year-over-year to $1.13 and net earnings grew to $1.06 billion, but most of that swing came from $291.6M of real estate disposition gains this quarter versus $57.5M a year earlier.
summary_long: Total revenue rose 11% y/y to $2.43B, split between rental revenue (+7.5% y/y to $2.18B) and strategic capital revenue (+64% y/y to $242M). Net earnings reached $1.06B (+86% y/y, +8% q/q), but most of that swing came from $291.6M of real estate disposition gains this quarter versus $57.5M a year ago — before gains, operating income rose a more modest 12.2% y/y to $959.7M. Same-store cash NOI grew 8.5% y/y (Prologis Share), and period-end occupancy held near 95%. Core FFO per share was $1.63 (+12% y/y). 2026 guidance calls for Core FFO of $6.22-$6.30/share and average occupancy of 95.25%-95.75%. Cash rose to $1.77B from $1.15B at year-end.
